description: Solve ax^2+bx+c=0 with full discriminant analysis.

faqs.a: The discriminant D = b²−4ac. D > 0 means two distinct real roots, D = 0 one repeated root, D < 0 two complex conjugate roots.
faqs.q: What does the discriminant tell me?

faqs.a: Then it is not quadratic — it is the linear equation bx+c=0. The tool rejects a=0 instead of solving the wrong equation.
As a±bi, the standard complex form, computed from the real part −b/2a and imaginary part √|D|/2a.

howto: Enter the coefficients a, b and c.
Read the discriminant, root nature and the roots.
See the vertex, axis of symmetry and factored form too.
title: Quadratic Equation Solver
